main_text.p: germanæ operam præstemus, malis artibus ;Mὴ συγκοινωνεῖν (inquit Paulus) μᾶλλον ἐλέγχετε : Feci-mus nos quidem modestè & serio : Idem nobis accidit, quod Apostolo ; ἐχθροὶ γεγόνα ὑμῖν ἀληθεύοντες : Ecce nos nunc extur-bamur foras, conspuimur, obruimur plane contumelijs, quæsitissimis denique pœnis afficimur. Et ne quid forte mali deesset, accessit demum errori pertinacia, natusque ex impatientia furor ; tantòque magis arridere cœpit vitium, quantò nobis displicere solet : Nos verò quid nunc agimus, exclusissimi, despicatissimique melioris pudicitiæ

page.notes: <note side="right">Ephes.5.11.</note> <note side="right">Gal.4.16.</note> <note side="left">Greek words in the text are as printed and may contain errors; the Greek in the first line (Mὴ συγκοινωνεῖν) and the Greek phrases are approximate transcriptions of the scan.</note>
